title: Paichai University says external hack exposed LMS and academic-system personal data
summary: Dailysecu reports that Paichai University posted a notice on 18 November saying an external hack on 16 November exposed personal data from its LMS and linked academic-affairs system, including names, emails and dates of birth. The university says resident registration, passport and driver's licence numbers were not leaked. The number of people affected has not been confirmed.
plain: A South Korean university says hackers got into its online learning and student-records systems and some personal details were exposed. It says national ID and passport numbers were not.
exec: A university breach exposed student and staff account and personal data; the number of people affected is not confirmed.
action: Paichai University users: follow the university's notice, use its lookup tool, and reset any password reused on other sites.

validation.note: Dailysecu only, relaying the university's own 18 Nov notice; the notice itself was not read.

review.note: Checked 16 Nov hack, 18 Nov notice, data items, ID numbers not leaked, no count stated against Dailysecu
